title: EzyFix Zanzibari Chicken Thighs Pandan-Leaf Wrap
description: A quick and sour Algerian dish featuring chicken thighs cooked in a blend of spices and rendered fat, wrapped in pandan leaves for added flavor.
instructions: In a pan, heat oil and render fat from chicken thighs until golden.
Add garlic, onion slices, and fresh herbs. Stir for about 1 minute.
Season with salt, pepper, and other preferred spices to taste.
Place chicken thighs in the rendered fat mixture, skin side up.
Wrap each chicken thigh individually with a pandan leaf.
Arrange wrapped chicken thighs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake at 180°C for about 25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot as a quick and sour Algerian dinner dish.
